verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs describe cloud mock servers set up in a few steps and self-hosted mock servers via Mockbin. Mocks can be auto-generated from an OpenAPI definition, JSON, a live URL response or a prompt, and dynamic Liquid-templated responses add request-aware and fake data. That covers the 'spin up from a spec so consumers can build early' core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of creating mocks from saved request examples or responses (only live URL responses are documented), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mocking workflow.
